name: Agentic PDLC Assistant
description: Automates the data-engineering Project Development Lifecycle (PDLC): turns a data request into lifecycle artifacts (triage, requirement analysis, HLD/ADR, JIRA breakdown) via a coordinator that routes to phase specialists, grounded in deterministic decision tools.

skills.name: Architecture & HLD Decisions
skills.description: Produces High-Level Design decisions and Architecture Decision Records for data pipelines — especially the load pattern and storage format for a source — grounded in a deterministic decision tree.
examples: How should I load a daily stock-price feed for 10 competitor tickers?
Full, incremental, or append-only for an immutable fact with restatement risk?
Parquet or Delta for a fact table that gets corporate-action restatements?

skills.name: Requirement Analysis & Source Feasibility
skills.description: Produces a structured Requirement Analysis and assesses whether a candidate data source/API is viable against expected call volume (rate limits, delay, tier, delta support), grounded in a verified-facts tool.
examples: Is Alpha Vantage viable for a daily tracker of 10 tickers?
Which stock API should I use for ~10 calls a day?
What should the Requirement doc cover for a competitor-watch dashboard?

skills.name: Intake & Triage
skills.description: Fast triage of a new data request — net-new vs existing, rough size, urgency — producing a one-paragraph triage note and a proceed/fast-track decision.
examples: We need a daily competitor stock tracker — where do we start?
Triage this new data request for me.

skills.name: JIRA Breakdown
skills.description: Breaks an approved design into an Epic -> Feature -> Story -> Task tree with acceptance criteria, sequencing infra prerequisites first and enforcing that every task traces to a requirement or ADR.
examples: Break the stock-tracker design into a JIRA backlog.
Give me the Epic/Feature/Story/Task breakdown with acceptance criteria.
